docs.text: Jigsaw Puzzle Application Overview Welcome to the Jigsaw Puzzle application! This web-based game allows users to solve jigsaw puzzles in an interactive drag-and-drop format. The application leverages WebSockets for real-time updates, ensuring that users can collaborate and solve puzzles together in a seamless manner. Features Real-time Interaction: The game allows multiple clients to join and solve puzzles simultaneously, with updates broadcast to all connected users. Drag-and-Drop Interface: Users can drag puzzle pieces and drop them onto the grid to assemble the puzzle. Puzzle Completion and Feedback: Once the puzzle is completed correctly, a success message appears, and users can move on to the next puzzle. Real-time Puzzle State Updates: Puzzle progress is synchronized in real-time across all clients.
